turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi! I recently placed an order. I would like to check my account for some information on it, but I cannot get on because I forgot my username. Can you help me, please?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I have your full name or your account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Joseph Banter and my account id is 78985

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I have your zip code and your phone number please?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can give you a new temporary username which you can change later.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can use this to log in now but we suggest changing it later.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will. Thank you for helping me today. That is all I needed.
